item.title: Gainax Renzoku Satsujin Jiken (Ero)
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Gainax
  • 発売日: 2000-07-14
  • スコア: なし (1 人評価)
  • 日本語名: ガイナックス連続殺人事件(エロ)
  • 英語名: Gainax Renzoku Satsujin Jiken (Ero)

别名

  • murder case in Gainax kakko ERO

あらすじ

Main character is a new editor who participates in Gainax new game planning meeting in the mountains. However, as soon as team gathers, storm breaks out cutting way back. Meanwhile, Gainax staff members start to get killed one after another. Can protagonist find a criminal and develop special relations with staff girls under these circumstances?

item.title: Cybernetic Hi-School Part 4 ~Ape Hunter J~
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Gainax
  • 発売日: 1991-07-20
  • スコア: 5.26/10 (5 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 電脳学園４ ～エイプハンターＪ～
  • 英語名: Cybernetic Hi-School Part 4 Ape Hunter J

别名

  • Dennou Gakuen 4

あらすじ

In 2006 the people had just one anxiety - “Monkey”. Elimination of ozone layer by ultraviolet rays after 1980s caused ape mutation evolution. Mutants were intelligent and since they started to look like humans they secretly infiltrated human society. Thus appeared ape hunters - specialists in identification and “processing” of monkeys.

item.title: Cybernetic Hi-School Part 3 ~Top o Nerae!~
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Gainax
  • 発売日: 1990-03-24
  • スコア: 5.37/10 (9 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 電脳学園３ ～トップをねらえ！～
  • 英語名: Cybernetic Hi-School Part 3 Top o Nerae!

别名

  • Dennou Gakuen 3

あらすじ

You, as an alpha-class Top, are supposed to win three keys to pilot the Great Gunbuster robot against the cosmic threat to humanity. The keys are held by Jung-Freud, Kazumi (oneesama) and Noriko, and you must retrieve the keys by defeating each character in a quiz game, which has the side-effect of stripping them of all their clothes.

item.title: Cybernetic Hi-School Part 2 ~Highway Buster!!~
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Gainax
  • 発売日: 1989-12-10
  • スコア: 5.36/10 (6 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 電脳学園２ ～ハイウェイバスター！！～
  • 英語名: Cybernetic Hi-School Part 2 Highway Buster!!

别名

  • Dennou Gakuen 2

あらすじ

Something strange is afoot in town. A midnight rider is assaulting drivers on the highway, bombarding them with tricky quiz questions. If the driver can’t answer the questions, he and his car is blown up. Out of fear of the so-called Highway Buster, people dare no longer use the highways.
